description: A self-hosted, ad-free, privacy-respecting metasearch engine.

promotion.reason: Qualified on 2026-09-11 and approved by the owner. A real install proved it starts, opens to a usable screen, survives a restart and a reinstall, and removes everything it created. 1.2.4 is upstream's current release, built 2026-04-15, published for amd64 and arm64. One container that keeps no data, so its keep-data checks pass trivially — the proof shows the page is the same after a reinstall, not that anything was preserved.

data_storage: None: it keeps no data of its own
risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps no data of its own, so there is nothing for an uninstall to keep or delete.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.

Every search you make is still sent to Google, from this computer's internet connection. What it removes is the tracking around it — no cookies, no JavaScript, no ads, and results with Google's redirect links stripped — not the search itself.
